criteria.text:
How we'll judge them

1. Orientation: always know which layer you're on and how far through the stack you are
2. Throughput: move file to file and hunk to hunk from the keyboard
3. Re-review: what changed since last time is obvious
4. Agent fit: findings land in context, are quick to triage, and it's clear what is published vs draft
5. Signal: checks, threads and CI failures visible without hunting
6. Calm: focus on the code, little chrome

All four use the same mock: 5-layer 'Rate limiting' stack, reviewing layer #413. Click layers, files, findings and buttons.

hybridTitle.text: Chosen direction: hybrid (B's flow + A's rail and dock + C's reading order + D as overview)

hybridFlow.text:
Prototype flow

Home → open a stack → Overview → Start review → Review

Press Play on Home and click through. Every stack row opens the Rate limiting mock.

In Review:
• collapse the layer rail
• toggle the agent dock
• j = mark viewed & next
• Draft / Dismiss findings in the margin
• Finish layer… opens the verdict
